name: Milgram: Podmena
source:
The main character moves from a big city to an urban-type settlement, and everything would be fine, but it happens in the middle of the school year... Now he needs to get to know his new classmates, make friends and try not to make enemies. Normal school life, shouldn't be difficult, right?
